g.text: Use Penryn CPU mode (recommended for older Intel CPUs)
Use e1000 network adapter (recommended for Xeon / older Intel - no kext needed)
Unattended install (BETA) - hands-off until Setup Assistant
Drives the whole install over the VM console: boots recovery, ERASES the new VM disk, runs the installer, and
handles every reboot. Verified on Ventura, Sonoma, Sequoia, and Tahoe. Leave the VM alone while it runs.
